name: Ulamog
description: Ulamog is one of the three Eldrazi titans, whose brood devours the life of Zendikar and who was worshipped as a god by some.

description_citations.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.
"The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

summary.text: Ulamog is one of the three Eldrazi titans, whose brood devours the life of Zendikar and who was worshipped as a god by some.

citations.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.
"The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

bio.text: Ulamog returned and devastated Nissa's Joraga tribe, and he later arrived on Zendikar alongside Kozilek and Emrakul, who were petrified over Akoum and sealed away.

citations.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.
"The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.
"The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: When he escaped his prison he destroyed Bala Ged first.
Ugin told Jace that Ulamog could not be killed and proposed imprisoning the Eldrazi again, while Jace learned he was heading for Sea Gate.

citations.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trapped Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
"Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis knocked a hedron out of alignment, freeing him and collapsing the network, and then called Kozilek from beneath Zendikar.

citations.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Kozilek freed his brother Ulamog, and the two titans wandered the land, with Sea Gate toppled.

citations.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.
"Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

bio.text: Finally, Chandra baited Ulamog while Nissa wove Zendikar's leylines into a glyph that bound the titans, and Chandra's fire along the leylines destroyed them.

citations.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

status.text: He is dead, destroyed with Kozilek near Sea Gate by the Gatewatch's founders, though later pages still recall him as a past threat.

citations.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Red Route" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
timeline.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cultists in Akoum, infected by Ulamog's creative force, perform rituals that loosen the prison's bonds.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane releases the titans, and Kozilek's brood is said to retreat to remote corners of the world.
timeline.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kozilek emerges from deep underground after Ob Nixilis drains the hedron network imprisoning Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Kozilek emerged from deep underground nearby.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar and his students take part in the Liberation of Sea Gate and drive off Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: helped in driving off Ulamog 's brood

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi titans arrive on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: descended upon Zendikar, their monstrous forms dwarfing everything in their path.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers activate the hedron network at the Eye of Ugin, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cultists of Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison and broods devastate Zendikar.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve surviving cultists become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reinforces the prison on her own and leaves; the vampires are freed of Ulamog's yoke.
timeline.quote: After Nahiri enforced the Eldrazi prison all on her own, no more broods came to life.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: freed the Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood causes the Slaughter at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Its brood caused the Slaughter at Sea Gate

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's infection transforms twelve Zendikari cultists into the first vampire bloodchiefs.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire species

citation.text: "Vampire", section "The Bloodchiefs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akoum cultists infected by Ulamog's influence perform rituals that loosen the Eldrazi prison.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa, believing the titans should be freed to return to the stars, shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood attacks the Joraga and Nissa barely survives as their only survivor, saved by Hamadi's band.
timeline.quote: Nissa had barely survived, a band of humans saving her, apparently the only survivor of the Joraga tribe.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Worldwaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An enormous Eldrazi rises beyond the valley and the brood surges toward the camp.
timeline.quote: Then a figure, impossibly large, rose up behind the hills on the far side of the valley.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana bores into the sire's heart and drinks its energy, recovering memories of her origin as a creature of Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I was no longer an extension of it, of the consuming force named Ulamog.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon's army, joined by Kiora and Nissa, retakes Sea Gate and Ulamog is trapped with hedrons.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were driven from the city

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Jace then activated the hedron's magics and trapped Ulamog.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate is overtaken by the Eldrazi; Tazri meets Gideon Jura at a refugee camp.
timeline.quote: She first met Gideon Jura in a refugee camp outside the city, after a battle with Ulamog's spawn.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jori En warns that Ulamog is approaching Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was approaching Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog is trapped, but Ob Nixilis disrupts the network, freeing Ulamog and waking Kozilek.
timeline.quote: the demon planeswalker Ob Nixilis appeared and disrupted the network, leaving Ulamog to ravage the city and waking Kozilek as well.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul and Kozilek vanish six months after release, leaving Ulamog to ravage Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Six months after they had been released, both Emrakul and Kozilek vanished, only leaving a few spawn behind.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace dominates Jori En's mind to send her back to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.
timeline.quote: Jace dominated Jori En's mind to force her to leave him and return to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa and Kiora retakes Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora assaulted and retook Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon wrestles Ulamog while Nissa unearths hedrons and Jace triggers them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace then triggered them, activating their latent magic and knocking the titan off balance while trapping him.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Everything looked to be smooth sailing until Ob Nixilis arrived, knocked the hedrons out of alignment, and positioned himself between them.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kozilek arrives and rebuffs Gideon's army.
timeline.quote: they were rebuffed by the arrival of a second titan: Kozilek

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The death of Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
timeline.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
timeline.quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
timeline.quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Channeling her flame through Zendikar's ley lines, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Nissa imprison Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate on Ugin's advice, but Ob Nixilis's interference makes it fail and he calls Kozilek to join Ulamog.
timeline.quote: That effort was briefly successful but ultimately failed due to interference by Ob Nixilis

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
timeline.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The binding locks and the titans begin to tear apart; Chandra asks to attack but Jace insists on his plan.
timeline.quote: but Jace insisted on proceeding with his original plan

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra attacks and Nissa channels leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and destroying both titans.
timeline.quote: The titans were destroyed in an enormous explosion.

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through the leylines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek; Ugin is angered.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant stroke of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Nissa devise a plan to destroy the titans permanently, breaking Jace's promise to Ugin.
timeline.quote: Jace and Nissa devised a plan to destroy Kozilek and Ulamog permanently

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Chandra's massive fire spell the Gatewatch kills the Eldrazi titans in Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Helped by a massive fire spell of Chandra, they succeeded.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns Ulamog and Kozilek through the ley lines, destroying both titans.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek are incinerated by Chandra's flames channeled through Nissa.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace trap Ulamog with the hedrons until Ob Nixilis destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kozilek slices Lorthos in half and turns on Kiora, who is left wounded.
timeline.quote: the titan destroyed Lorthos by slicing it in half using its arm blades

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora urges releasing the titans but Chandra burns them through Nissa's ley lines, destroying Ulamog and Kozilek; Kiora leaves alone.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines and burns them, ending Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Kozilek on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Linked with Nissa, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa join forces against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis, becoming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: They become the Gatewatch , a team with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the card Bonds of Mortality, Nissa and Jace weaken the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In the first card, Nissa and Jace weaken the Eldrazi Titans, Ulamog, and Kozilek.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Notable cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the card Fall of the Titans, Chandra and Gideon take both titans out.
timeline.quote: In the second one Chandra and Gideon take them both out.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Notable cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch destroys Kozilek and Ulamog.
timeline.quote: the Gatewatch defeats Kozilek and Ulamog .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch and Kiora, devising a leyline plan with Nissa and using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora's help.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through Nissa and the ley lines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
timeline.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
timeline.quote: His army was gone.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
timeline.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's brood attack the Infinite Guideline Station around 4564 AR.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi of what appeared to be Ulamog's brood attacked the Infinite Guideline Station and its occupants around 4564 AR

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Edge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
timeline.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

citation.text: "Red Route" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2020.
